name: statictsc
description: StaticTS: an ahead-of-time compiler from a static subset of TypeScript to LLVM IR

scripts.example: npm run build && node dist/index.js examples/add.ts -o build/add.ll && cat build/add.ll
scripts.size-report: npm run build && node dist/index.js examples/add.ts -o build/add.ll && bash scripts/size-report.sh build/add.ll examples/main.c
scripts.test:update: npm run build && UPDATE_GOLDENS=1 node tests/run.js
